wants.topic: Historical perspective on how Hindu festivals were celebrated 100 years ago (1920s vintage/retro format)
wants.evidence: The Divine Journey videos on '100 साल पहले Chhath Puja', '100 साल पहले धनतेरस', and '1926 में Diwali' generated massive engagement with vsNormal between 42.26 and 62.51.

wants.topic: Timely Vrat Kathas released right before seasonal festivals with full story twist and Puja Vidhi
wants.evidence: FaKT Dharmik Katha videos on Karwa Chauth (vsNormal 8.08), Gopashtami (vsNormal 8.11), and Amla Navami (vsNormal 10.97) heavily outperformed daily routine content.

wants.topic: Heart-touching Jagannath Puri Mahaprabhu & Sant Prakash Das Ji devotional Bhajans
wants.evidence: Divine Soul India video 'तू ना संभाले तो हमें कौन संभाले | Jagannath Chaka Nain' achieved vsNormal of 13.63.

gaps: 100-year historical documentary style applied to ancient temple traditions and lesser-known regional Hindu festivals.
Detailed narrative Kathas explaining the deep spiritual 'why' behind specific Hindu rituals rather than just routine speed-reading of standard fast stories.
saturated: Generic, off-season routine Vrat Kathas (e.g., standard Papankusha Ekadashi or Tuesday Mangalwar Vrat Katha uploaded out of key festival windows).
Generic Nonstop Nirgun / Chetawani Geet without strong artist branding or visual storytelling.
